story: Detroit came back from 14 down and San Antonio cut it to 95–90 with 2:36 left. Daniss Jenkins' three off an Ausar Thompson steal made it 100–90, and the Pistons won 105–93.
aria: Animated Short: Daniss Jenkins' 3-pointer off an Ausar Thompson steal with 1:45 left that put Detroit up 100 to 90. Pistons win 105–93 and end the Spurs' 12-game win streak. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
